name: high-signal-news
description: High-signal news aggregation and briefing generation for AI, software development, and tech investment

database.description: SQLite database with articles, sources, feed_entries tables

rss_aggregation.description: Feed fetching, content extraction, deduplication pipeline
issues: Content extraction has timeout errors on some articles

content_extraction.description: Jina AI Reader integration for full content extraction with retry logic and rate limiting
improvements: Added retry logic with exponential backoff (max 3 retries)
Increased timeout to 30 seconds for slower sites
Removed source whitelist - now processes ALL pending articles
Improved error categorization (paywalled vs failed vs rss-only)

sources_catalog.description: 30 high-quality sources configured including HN, AI newsletters, dev blogs

cron_jobs.description: Scheduled aggregation runs via systemd timers

issues.description: Theme detection is naive - counts per-source rather than cross-source analysis
Newsletter 'Why it matters' is generic pattern matching, not content analysis

resolved.resolution: Improved extraction script with retry logic, rate limiting, and removed source whitelist. Extraction success rate now 93% (54/58 articles).

next_steps: Fix newsletter 'Why it matters' to use actual content analysis
Validate newsletter quality with human review
